hooks.text: 动力手套既能扫描敌人与资源，也能推拉敌人并操纵遗迹环境。
hooks.excerpt: Scan for enemies and resources using your AVARITE POWERED GLOVES ! Have fun pushing and pulling enemies through lairs and ruins. Use this same ability to manipulate your environment!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 在巢穴与遗迹采集稀有资源，制作移动医疗站和钻机升级等科技。
hooks.excerpt: Collect rare resources throughout the lairs and ruins then use them to craft technology like mobile medical bays and upgrades for the drilling rig.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每次向星球深处钻探都会生成新的环境、敌人与宝藏组合。
hooks.excerpt: With our PROCEDURALLY GENERATED LEVELS , each descent is a new challenge, presenting new environments, enemies, and treasures.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
